description: This test file verifies the handling of zero completion tokens in the litellm library, specifically focusing on the LowestLatencyLoggingHandler's robustness against division by zero errors during logging of success events. It contains two main tests: one for log_success_event handling with zero completion tokens, and another for the time_to_first_token calculation in streaming responses.

classes.name: LowestLatencyLoggingHandler
classes.description: The routing handler class tested for robustness against zero tokens issues, imported from litellm.router_strategy.lowest_latency.

methods.name: test_zero_completion_tokens_no_division_error()
methods.description: Test that log_success_event handles zero completion tokens without raising a ZeroDivisionError.

methods.name: test_zero_completion_tokens_with_time_to_first_token()
methods.description: Test that time_to_first_token calculation handles zero completion tokens without errors.
